overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on either allegation: the Feb 26, 2026 notice was sufficiently specific given the Board's prior discussions, and the chair may permit public comment despite a notice saying none would be taken.

allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law when the Chair allowed members of the public to participate even though the notice indicated that there would be no public comment.
